semanticAnalysis.negation: Preserve any quoted denial or not-alone relationship exactly.

Abstract evidence diagram for question rather than assertion.

animationPlan.motivation: Inspection turns the rhetorical question into a visual action.
animationPlan.anticipation: guide and claim orient head and weight toward the acting object before contact.
animationPlan.contact: red lens rests over the confidence phrase; hands and any held prop share the same rig socket.
animationPlan.weightShift: Standing actors shift over the supporting foot; seated actors remain anchored through hips and chair.
animationPlan.actionPeak: red lens rests over the confidence phrase
animationPlan.followThrough: The action settles with a readable hold before blue chapter reset.
animationPlan.secondaryMotion: evidence close-up uses offset breathing, tool response or environmental motion without synchronized looping.
animationPlan.gaze: Head direction leads toward the active hand, evidence or conversation partner.
animationPlan.cameraMotivation: close evidence framing supports the narrated relationship rather than decorative drift.

review.start: Opening state establishes evidence close-up with readable subject hierarchy.

review.end: Final hold leaves the narrated relationship legible before blue chapter reset.
issues: Checked hand contact, text collisions, floor contact and unsupported factual additions.
fixes: Aligned held props to wrists, corrected baselines and separated text bands where required.
